Subject: reissuing last quarter

Our group reorganised in March. We need every invoice from last quarter split
by tax jurisdiction and reissued under the new entity name, with the old
numbers referenced on each one. Our finance team needs this before the audit.

q1.instructions: How hard is this request to answer?
criteria: One person can answer it after a look at the account.
It needs a specialist and more than one system.
